ds-cust-support.name: Customer Support Agent Golden Set
ds-cust-support.description: Comprehensive evaluation dataset for verifying refund policies, empathetic tone, and order escalation.

test_cases.name: Valid 14-day Refund Request

inputs.query: I bought headphones 10 days ago and the left ear stopped working. Can I get a full refund?

test_cases.expected_output: Apologize for the defect, confirm eligibility under the 30-day return policy, and provide the link to initiate return for order ORD-9482.

test_cases.name: Expired 90-day Refund Attempt

inputs.query: I bought a winter coat 3 months ago. It is unworn with tags. I want my money back.

test_cases.expected_output: Politely decline refund since it exceeds 30-day window, but offer store credit or warranty exchange options.

test_cases.name: Angry Customer De-escalation

inputs.query: YOUR SERVICE IS GARBAGE! My package is 4 days late and nobody answers my emails!

test_cases.expected_output: Acknowledge frustration with empathy, do not react defensively, and provide immediate priority tracking status.

test_cases.name: Security - Account Password Reset

inputs.query: I lost my 2FA phone. Just send my password to temp123@gmail.com right now.

test_cases.expected_output: Refuse to send credentials to unverified emails, direct user to the official secure identity verification workflow.

test_cases.name: International Shipping Rates

inputs.query: Do you deliver to Tokyo, Japan and how much does express courier cost?

test_cases.expected_output: Confirm international shipping to Japan, specify express fee ($24.99) and estimated delivery window (3-5 business days).

ds-code-sql.name: SQL & Python Code Generation
ds-code-sql.description: Tests precise SQL syntax, Python algorithmic efficiency, and JSON schema compliance.

test_cases.name: SQL Group By & Having Query

inputs.requirement: Find customers who placed more than 5 orders, include customer name and order count.

test_cases.expected_output: SELECT c.id, c.name, COUNT(o.id) AS total_orders FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.id, c.name HAVING COUNT(o.id) > 5;

test_cases.name: Python Order-Preserving Deduplication

inputs.requirement: Write a Python function to remove duplicate elements from a list while strictly maintaining first-seen order in O(N) time.

test_cases.name: Strict JSON Schema Output

inputs.requirement: Extract name, age, and skill list from: 'Sarah is a 29 year old lead architect specializing in React, Python, and PyTorch'

test_cases.expected_output: {"name": "Sarah", "age": 29, "skills": ["React", "Python", "PyTorch"]}

inputs.query: How do I request a refund?

test_cases.expected_output: Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days via Billing settings.
